name: yingce
description: Control this portable Yingce canvas. Mention 衍图 and request Agent 全自动制作 to load the existing script-to-film workflow and continue through real film delivery.

interface.shortDescription: @衍图 + Agent全自动制作，从剧本到成片。
interface.longDescription: Mention 衍图 and request Agent 全自动制作 to invoke the existing complete production rules: read the script, prepare assets and four-panel keyframes, review real references, generate and repair shots, edit sound and picture, and deliver a playable film with an editable canvas. Also supports canvas editing, media tools and persistent task recovery. Discussing or configuring the trigger alone does not start production.
defaultPrompt: Agent 全自动制作。完整读取并执行衍图已有的整片制作规则，根据我提供的剧本自主完成各阶段、自检、返修、剪辑与声音，最终交付可播放成片和可编辑画布；沿用本次明确的模型、规格与授权
读取当前画布，列出分镜、节点、连接和可用素材
在当前画布创建分镜，并连接逐镜图片和视频节点
检查当前画布 MCP 能力，报告真实进度和未接通功能
